The '''Red Legion''' was a Sith special military unit that existed within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the time of the [[Great Galactic War]]. The unit's specialty was killing and assassination. It was commanded by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Ekkage]] and led by the Sith Lord [[Darth Rictus]].
